C50-I02.resolution: Reuse the full canonical Phase 49 sign-consensus taxonomy verbatim (6 classes: ALL_UNDER / ALL_OVER / ALL_EXACT / TWO_UNDER_ONE_OVER / TWO_OVER_ONE_UNDER / MIXED). If Phase 50 later needs a reduced taxonomy, the mapping must be deterministic and explicitly documented before aggregation.

C50-I03.resolution: R² undefined policy: r2_status = 'NOT_DEFINED' (explicit string); CSV numeric R² field = empty (no characters between commas); JSON numeric R² field = null. Never fabricate R² = 0.

C50-I04.resolution: Authorize creation of a Phase 50-specific Train-only target population SHA256 (REGIME_REFERENCE_TRAIN-v1 sha256). Must be computed deterministically from canonical Train target IDs (UTF-8, sorted, LF-separated). Store provenance (source path: artifacts/windows/common_target_population.csv filtered by target_split_id==TRAIN) and serialization method in regime_thresholds_train_only.json.target_ids_sha256 and regime_reference_train_manifest.json. FROZEN before Stage A threshold derivation.

C50-I09.resolution: Do NOT overwrite ambiguous upstream handoffs destructively. The Phase 49 → Phase 50 consumption handoff under artifacts/residual_analysis/phase50_handoff.json is the CANONICAL consumption handoff. If Phase 50 needs a new input-gates artifact, create a new uniquely-named Phase 50-owned file (e.g., artifacts/error_by_regime/phase50_input_gates.json). The 541-byte Phase 47 placeholder at artifacts/final_test/phase50_error_regime_handoff.json is preserved untouched as historical Phase 47 evidence.
